help.description: Export, import and verify Dify knowledge bases chunk-for-chunk using only the public Knowledge API. Connection settings come from DIFY_SRC_API_URL / DIFY_SRC_API_KEY (source) and DIFY_DST_API_URL / DIFY_DST_API_KEY (target).
help.epilog: Exit codes: 0 identical / ok, 1 differences found, 2 usage or authentication error, 3 API or indexing failure.
help.lang: screen language: en or ko (default: DIFY_KB_PORT_LANG, then LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG)
help.export: export a knowledge base from the source instance into a bundle directory
help.import: create a knowledge base on the target instance from a bundle, then verify it
help.verify: compare a bundle with a knowledge base on the target instance (exit 1 on differences)
help.diff: compare two sides; each is a bundle path, src:<dataset_id> or dst:<dataset_id>
help.demo: run a keyless round trip against a built-in practice mock server
help.mock_server: start only the practice mock Dify server so you can try the real commands
help.force: write into an existing non-empty directory
help.name: name for the new knowledge base (default: the original name)
help.into: import into this existing dataset id instead of creating a new one
help.on_conflict: with --into, what to do when a document name already exists: skip (default) or replace
help.dry_run: check the target and report what would be created; sends no write requests
help.resume: continue an interrupted import from its checkpoint
help.no_verify: skip the automatic verify after importing
help.index_timeout: seconds to wait for the target to finish indexing one document (default 600)
help.left: expected side (bundle path, src:<id> or dst:<id>)
help.right: side to check (bundle path, src:<id> or dst:<id>)
err.missing_env: missing environment variable {var}; set it (see .env.example). Keys are read from the environment only, never from arguments.
err.auth: the server at {url} rejected the API key (HTTP {status}: {message}). Check that the key is a Knowledge API key (dataset-...). On Dify 1.18+ a resource token only sees the knowledge bases it is bound to; create a workspace-level key to cover all of them.
err.bad_spec: cannot read {spec!r}: use a bundle directory, src:<dataset_id> or dst:<dataset_id>
import.doc_exists: [{index}/{count}] {name}: already exists in the target, skipped (--on-conflict skip)
import.skip_form: warning: {name} uses a document form this version cannot import (e.g. hierarchical_model); it is skipped
dry.summary: dry run: would create {documents} documents with {chunks} chunks (at most {requests} write requests). Nothing was changed.
dry.no_embedding: warning: dataset {dataset} reports no usable embedding model; configure one before importing
dry.qa_needs_llm: warning: {count} Q&A document(s) make the target generate Q&A once per document; its system model must be configured
demo.banner: This is a practice mock that reproduces the Dify 1.20.0 service API contract - not a real Dify server.
demo.step_seed: [1/4] Seeding a source knowledge base with hand edits (edited text, keywords, a disabled chunk, a manual chunk, Korean text, metadata team=cs)
demo.step_import: [3/4] Importing into a new knowledge base on the same mock
demo.step_naive: [4/4] Contrast: re-uploading the original source file with default splitting
demo.disabled: disabled chunk stays disabled in the target: {value}
demo.next: Next: run `dify-kb-port mock-server --seed` and practise export / import / verify yourself with the dataset id it prints (key: dataset-mock).
mock.listening: practice mock Dify listening on {url} (API key: {api_key}). Press Ctrl-C to stop.
mock.seeded: seeded practice knowledge base "{name}" (hand-edited, like the demo): dataset id {dataset}
mock.try:
Try it from another terminal:
  export DIFY_SRC_API_URL={url} DIFY_SRC_API_KEY={api_key}
  export DIFY_DST_API_URL={url} DIFY_DST_API_KEY={api_key}
  dify-kb-port export --dataset {dataset} --out ./faq-bundle
  dify-kb-port import ./faq-bundle --dry-run
  dify-kb-port import ./faq-bundle --name "FAQ (copy)"
  dify-kb-port verify ./faq-bundle --dataset <id printed by import>
help.seed: create the demo's hand-edited knowledge base on start and print its id, so export / import / verify can be practised right away
import.nothing_verified: nothing was imported: every document was skipped, so this import verified nothing.
import.kept_match: skipped documents already match the bundle ({count}): {names}
import.kept_differ: warning: {count} skipped document(s) differ from the bundle and were left as they are: {names}. Run `dify-kb-port verify` to see the differences, or import again with --on-conflict replace to overwrite them.
err.connect: cannot reach {url} ({detail}). Check that the server is running and that DIFY_SRC_API_URL / DIFY_DST_API_URL points to it (the service API base ending in /v1).
err.port: cannot listen on port {port} ({detail}); choose another one with --port.
err.resume_hint: The checkpoint (if any) is kept; fix the cause and rerun with --resume.
err.url_scheme: API URL must start with http:// or https:// (got {url!r}).
err.not_json: the server at {url} did not return JSON; the API URL must be the service API base ending in /v1 (not the Dify web UI address).
err.out_exists: {out} already exists and is not empty; choose another --out or pass --force.
err.not_bundle: {path} is not a bundle (no {manifest}); create one with `dify-kb-port export`.
err.bundle_corrupt: {file} is corrupted ({detail}); the bundle cannot be read, export it again.
err.bad_format: unsupported bundle format {fmt}; this version reads {supported}.
err.segments_missing: {file} is missing; the bundle is incomplete, export it again.
err.checksum: checksum mismatch for document {name}; the bundle was modified or is corrupted, export it again.
err.external: external knowledge bases hold no chunks in Dify and cannot be exported.
err.checkpoint_unreadable: cannot read checkpoint {path}: {detail}; delete it to start over.
err.index_failed: indexing failed on the target: {detail}; check that the target has an embedding model configured.
err.index_timeout: indexing did not finish within {seconds}s; raise --index-timeout or check the target's workers and embedding model.
err.checkpoint_exists: found an unfinished import checkpoint ({path}); rerun with --resume to continue it, or delete the file to start over.
err.checkpoint_target: the checkpoint belongs to {saved}, not {target}; use the same DIFY_DST_API_URL or delete the checkpoint.
err.no_checkpoint: --resume given but {path} does not exist; run the import without --resume first.
err.no_chunks: document {name} has no chunks and cannot be created from text.
err.separator_conflict: separator {sep} occurs in document {name}; re-export the bundle.
err.positive: must be a number greater than 0 (got {value}).
